notes.title: Q1 2020 Content Update Information (02/13/2020)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35980351/8bf6e6f2f63c312a5a500af17460c408cc7ed5e0.png[/img]

Today we're releasing our Q1 2020 Content Update! This time around we have 9 new PBA Pros, 20 new bowling balls, and a variety of new commentary. Additionally, we've adjusted the timing for skipping animations, making the gameplay feel faster when you want it to.
[list]
[*] Nine new PBA Pros added.
[*] 20 new bowling balls added.
[*] New commentary added.
[*] Player and AI bowler transitions between throws have been sped up for faster gameplay.
[*] Updates to Pro Trivia.
[*] Left Stick works again for throwing with Arcade controls.
[*] Fixed bug where spare leaves were occasionally credited as a strike.
[*] General bug fixing.
[/list]

If you find any issues please report them to our support team by email at support@farsightstudios.com !

notes.title: Update Information (11/06/2019)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35980351/b5a8470c8a12a8e9649f325634c544e1b8450f75.png[/img]
After a lot of testing and discussion we are releasing our next patch today! In this update we have fixed several important issues, including oil patterns!
[list]
[*]Added additional options for the ball contact camera. It will now be straight on the head pin by default.
[*]In simulation mode your release angle will now be reset after every throw
[*]Updated simulation mode tutorial text
[*]Updated the layout of the settings menu to improve navigation
[*]Fixed Oil Patterns not affecting the ball physics
[*]Fixed the simulation mode tutorial skipping a step
[*]Fixed the tutorial causing local multiplayer to break in simulation mode
[*]Fixed several localization issues
[/list]
If you find any more issues please report them to our support team by email at support@farsightstudios.com!

notes.title: Update Information (10/23/2019)
notes.content:
After the game launched today we found several issues that needed to be resolved. We are also adjusting the controls for simulation mode slightly.
[list]
[*]Added VSync option to the Video Settings
[*]Adjusted the difficulty of throwing perfectly in simulation mode
[*]Adjusted the controller deadzone to help prevent the game from getting stuck in the throw state
[*]Adjusted the maximum amount of ball spin in simulation mode
[*]Updated the simulation mode tutorial
[*]Fixed Trophy details displaying an incorrect rank
[*]Fixed the Championship Midwest Finals challenge
[*]Fixed several localization issues
[*]Fixed not being able to throw with the mouse in simulation mode
[/list]
If you find any more issues please report them to our support team by email at support@farsightstudios.com!
